function: Converts Cartesian (x,y) coordinates to road-relative curvilinear coordinates (s: longitudinal station, d: lateral offset)
Generates jerk-minimizing lateral and longitudinal trajectories satisfying comfort acceleration limits (<2 m/s³ jerk)
Autonomous behavioral decision states: Cruise, Yield, Gap-Follow, Lateral Swerve, Emergency Deceleration
Executes optimal wheel steering angle and front/rear brake torque matching trajectory curvature
